blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Philippines — Bohol is being recommended for being declared under a state of calamity as prolonged dry conditions caused by El Niño have damaged crops worth an estimated P360.8 million and affected more than 15,000 farmers across the province. The Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (PDRRMC) made the recommendation during a meeting on Monday, Nov. 16, attended by concerned government agencies to discuss the latest weather projections and preparations for the anticipated effects of El Niño. Gov. Erico Aristotle Aumentado said the recommendation would facilitate the release of funds and the delivery of assistance and other support […]...
